scope: Semantic evidence audit of exact current narration and both opening alternatives; source-image interpretation and provenance. Not a story critic, phone-playback or provider verdict.

sentences.sentence: A phone recording isn't a diagnosis.
sentences.reason: Protocol explicitly states experimental and non-diagnostic results; narration is contextual to this study.

sentences.sentence: Womb Watch is recruiting in Austin, Houston and Galveston.
sentences.reason: All three Texas sites are registry-listed as recruiting at retrieval.

sentences.sentence: The study uploads phone recordings to a Texas computing center.
sentences.reason: Registry describes uploading audio to Texas Advanced Computing Center; protocol confirms internally hosted model.

sentences.sentence: Artificial intelligence estimates movement, breathing and hiccups.
sentences.reason: AI is employed to assess gross body movements, fetal breathing and hiccups. Estimate appropriately avoids proven reliability.

sentences.sentence: The app is designed to return those movement patterns.
sentences.reason: Protocol documents intended Trends interface; not actual trial results.
Sources explicitly identify noise disrupting recording and a Recording Failed screen.
Sources offer deletion and re-recording; can preserves optionality.

sentences.sentence: Researchers are testing daily use and tracking participants' anxiety.
sentences.reason: Daily-use procedure, real-world feasibility outcome and anxiety surveys support both clauses.

sentences.sentence: The app's own instructions say it isn't intended to determine decreased fetal movements.
sentences.reason: Exact independently inspected instruction warning explicitly disclaims determining decreased fetal movements.
Protocol explicitly states experimental and non-diagnostic results; neither sentence claims clinical utility.

sentences.sentence: An analyzed recording still isn't a diagnosis.
sentences.reason: Protocol explicitly states experimental and non-diagnostic results; neither sentence claims clinical utility.

opening_alternatives.result: Both source-backed opening images are valid protocol examples with persistent disclosure; no claimed observed outcome.

visual_findings: Independent protocol hash matches source hash in board.
Instructions, Recording, Failure and Trends public images match decoded embedded PDF images pixel for pixel.
Instruction warning independently transcribed and verified as c17; no warning attributed to Trends screenshot.
Trends values are visibly retained source examples; narration and disclosure do not interpret their numbers as results.
Noise notice and experimental/anxiety excerpts preserve source wording and its meaning.
No authentic fetal audio, live participant performance, clinical reassurance or benefit is established by these source images.
limitations: Rendered legibility, persistent disclosure visibility and phone pacing require the independent visual/phone review.
Full pre-voice gate also requires separate critic and opening-preview evidence; planning-only checks prove evidence bindings only.
Existing rejected claims and source discrepancies remain in claims.json; this audit does not erase them.

source_attribution_followthrough.evidence: Retained independently fetched PDF title page explicitly reads Document Date: 31JULY2026; principal investigators are affiliated with UT Austin.
source_attribution_followthrough.scope: Date/source attribution evidence and unchanged narration only. Earlier full-board bindings remain retained; diagram geometry, Instructions framing and opening focus changes require separate critic review.
